acl.axisTested: Reading/writing restrictions, bypass attempts (getPrototypeOf/Reflect/pollution), and measured limits.
acl.safeOperatingEnvelope: Up to 100,000 operations, latency < 35ms (throughput ~3.3M ops/sec), shallow property access.
acl.degradedBoundary: High nesting depths trigger linear slowdown (100+ ms per mutation) due to chain traversal.
acl.refusedBoundary: Direct unauthorized access to restricted keys throws access control violation.
acl.failedBrokenPoint: getPrototypeOf and Reflect.getPrototypeOf bypass ACL proxy traps completely and return target prototype.

transactions.axisTested: Nesting depth limits, rollback contamination metrics.
transactions.degradedBoundary: Nesting depth > 100 (execution latency increases linearly, e.g. 1,000 deep takes ~100ms, heap delta ~14MB).
transactions.refusedBoundary: Re-registering existing transaction interceptors or transactional rollback failure.
transactions.failedBrokenPoint: Call stack limits (V8 maximum recursion depth ~10,000 frames) leading to StackOverflow/RangeError.

replay.axisTested: Sample counts, divergence rates, non-determinism breaking points.
replay.highestToleratedLimit: Deterministic replay sequences converge with 100% precision.
replay.safeOperatingEnvelope: Seeded Mulberry32 PRNG and logical context-injected clock (ctx.clock()).
replay.degradedBoundary: Clock skew or minor drift in asynchronous task execution.
replay.refusedBoundary: Mutation validation rules triggered on state divergence checks.
replay.failedBrokenPoint: Use of unseeded Math.random(), raw Date.now(), or network-dependent IO immediately causes 100% replay divergence.

invariants.highestToleratedLimit: Custom guards prevent infinite recursion at depth 2.
invariants.safeOperatingEnvelope: Programmatic context-local recursion guards enabled for all cross-field constraints.
invariants.degradedBoundary: Custom validation loops taking up to 5-10ms.
invariants.refusedBoundary: Validation rules triggered on target range checks.
invariants.failedBrokenPoint: Circular dependency loops without guards crash at V8 stack limits (depth ~485 frames, throws Fatal Jidoka Error/RangeError).

sandbox.axisTested: Key filters, prototype escape attempts, scope sizes.
sandbox.highestToleratedLimit: Basic property reads/writes under sandbox boundary are fully isolated.
sandbox.safeOperatingEnvelope: Simple shallow key isolation, standard objects, no prototype traversal.
sandbox.degradedBoundary: Memory overhead of Proxy wrapping on access.
sandbox.refusedBoundary: Unauthorized key access within restrictedKeys throws block/refusal.
sandbox.failedBrokenPoint: Prototype pollution/traversal via Object.getPrototypeOf(proxy) or nested object reference leakage (proxy.nested returns raw reference, bypassing sandbox).

multitenancy.axisTested: Tenant scaling limits, memory bleed metrics.
multitenancy.safeOperatingEnvelope: Up to 5,000 tenants, with periodic config purging.
multitenancy.degradedBoundary: Spawning tenants without decommissioning causes memory leak in strong Map `tenantConfigs`, keeping memory elevated (e.g. 34.69 MB).
multitenancy.failedBrokenPoint: Heap exhaustion (OOM) when running infinite tenants without GC capability.

audit.safeOperatingEnvelope: Up to 10,000 entries (heap overhead ~20MB). Stream flushing to DB or disk after 5,000 entries.
audit.degradedBoundary: Heap growth from 34MB to 68MB (peak 80MB) and RSS of 191MB.
audit.refusedBoundary: Filter rules rejecting unauthorized audit events.
audit.failedBrokenPoint: includeStackTrace: true increases memory overhead by 15x, causing Heap Collapse (OOM) at high frequencies.

virtualValues.axisTested: Compute recursion depth, circular computation recovery.
virtualValues.safeOperatingEnvelope: Memoized virtual fields up to 100 levels (0ms resolution).
virtualValues.degradedBoundary: Non-memoized recursive lookups (O(2^N) or O(N) evaluation time, leading to minor ms latency).
virtualValues.failedBrokenPoint: Circular virtual dependency loop (vA -> vB -> vA) without cycle checks crashes V8 with RangeError.

contracts.degradedBoundary: Post-condition method wrappers add minimal call latency.
contracts.refusedBoundary: Contract violations throw error and trigger transaction rollback.
contracts.failedBrokenPoint: Execution context failure or thread freezing.

simulation.axisTested: Simulation block nesting limits, concurrent write consistency.
simulation.safeOperatingEnvelope: Shallow simulations with standard local state rollback.
simulation.degradedBoundary: Nested simulation shadowing causes spillover into outer context.
simulation.refusedBoundary: Target range checks or verification rules aborting simulation.
simulation.failedBrokenPoint: V8 Proxy Receiver Leak (passing proxy as receiver to Reflect.set writes directly to original target state, bypassing isolation).
